# Third-party assets for the sunnypilot web HUD

Served by `openpilot/sunnypilot/webhud/server.py`; kept here so lint, spellcheck and the file-size
check skip them.

| Path | What | Source / license |
|------|------|------------------|
| `three/three.module.min.js` | three.js r160 (single-file module build; r160 still supports WebGL 1 for older in-car browsers) | npm `three@0.160.1`, MIT (`three/LICENSE`) |
| `three/OrbitControls.js`, `three/GLTFLoader.js`, `three/BufferGeometryUtils.js` | three.js r160 examples, imports rewritten to `./three.module.min.js` so no import map is needed | same |
| `models/pulse_ocean_v0.10.glb` | Fisker Ocean 3D model, ego car: detailed, rigged (steering, wheels, doors, lamps), with paint and wheel options | Pulse Ocean v0.10, `Pulse-Ocean-ADAS.glb` unmodified (`models/LICENSE.md`) |
| `dbc/fisker_ocean_adas_world.dbc` | ADASBUS messages the HUD visualizes, cut from the FM29 ADASBUS matrix (V390.8) | generated by `python -m openpilot.sunnypilot.webhud.tools.gen_world_dbc <matrix.dbc>` |

The DBC keeps the matrix's comments verbatim, typos included.
